Roaming 0.5995 EUR/kWh stays in the eMSP layer and is not attached to third-party physical CPOs.

ROAD public charge flow accepts the 7-digit EVSE station identifier from BNetzA/Pluq EVSE IDs and exposes the current Pluq ad-hoc tariff without authentication. Verified German examples: DE*EFL*EV7062634 at 0.44 EUR/kWh and DE*EFL*EV0365296 at 0.51 EUR/kWh. A full collector now derives station IDs from germany-crosswalk.json and fetches exact EVSE-scoped prices; unpriced points remain visible but unranked.
Location-specific AFIR pricing is collected at exact EVSE scope.
Official Bilkraft/Eviny own-network fast-charging tariff is integrated for DC/HPC only; no AC or roaming extrapolation.

eParkstation allows each site/owner to configure kWh, parking and blocking fees independently, so no operator-wide price is valid. Current AFIR public matching is materially incomplete. Verified exact station/point tariffs remain rankable; unknown BNetzA sites stay visible and unpriced.

OPG is a verified public CPO with its own charging card and ad-hoc QR flow. Official site-specific evidence at Klinikum Osnabrück gives 0.49 EUR/kWh with OPG E-LadeCard and 0.55 EUR/kWh ad-hoc. Do not extrapolate those values across all OPG AC/DC sites until a current universal tariff table or exact station feed is resolved.

A current exact public station-level direct price is verified at Areal Böhler Autowerk in Meerbusch: 0.49 EUR/kWh ad-hoc on six 22 kW AC points, updated 2026-05-15. Nearby inno2grid stations still publish the direct price as unknown, so 0.49 EUR/kWh must not be extrapolated network-wide. Continue resolving exact QR/backend prices per station/EVSE; unknown points remain visible and unranked.
Official 2026 own-network card, customer and ad-hoc tariffs plus blocking fee are integrated.

Official own-network AC tariff is integrated at 0.45 EUR/kWh. DC is deliberately deferred because SÜC publishes 0.54 EUR/kWh up to 50 kW and 0.59 EUR/kWh for faster/hyperchargers with different blocking thresholds; a single DC fallback would be unsafe.
Public direct.wirelane.com pages expose current EVSE-specific ad-hoc price and fees using the EVSE ID in a reproducible URL. Full collector added; no operator-wide fallback is inferred.
Qwello's public tariff site loads all tariffs from an unauthenticated tariff-view.json feed. Collector preserves EVSE-specific kWh, minute, day/night and grace-period components.

No safe universal CPO price is published; applicable chargepoint pricing is shown before charging in the E.ON Drive experience. Keep sites visible and unpriced until a reproducible public station feed is resolved; do not invent a fallback.

The official TEAG Mobil promotion valid 2026-07-23 through 2026-09-30 is exact for sessions started and billed in the TEAG Mobil app on TEAG chargepoints: the first 28 kWh cost 0.49 EUR/kWh and energy from the 29th kWh costs 0.29 EUR/kWh. Other payment/access methods use the tariff displayed at the station or in the billing system. Do not flatten the tiered app tariff into a universal CPO price and do not extrapolate it to QR/card sessions.

Official enercity guidance states that direct FlexLaden pricing is shown on the station display and that selected stations can use dynamic pricing. There is therefore no safe universal ad-hoc fallback. Resolve exact station/EVSE prices and scope future matches by physical operator because the DE*ENC prefix also contains a small number of non-enercity points.

policy: Station-specific operators do not block the Germany pipeline unless no current price can be obtained at either operator or exact station/EVSE scope. Rank only verified exact scopes; keep unknown stations visible and unpriced. eMSP roaming prices never substitute for an unresolved physical-CPO direct price.
